title: Asiad: Carlo Paalam edges Indian foe, advances to quarterfinals
summary: Decorated Filipino boxer Carlo Paalam marched to the quarterfinals of the men's 55kg weight class in the 2026 Asian Games after beating his Indian opponent, Saturday at the Nishio Gym.
